hints.title: Calculate Press Durations
hints.text: The duration of the first keypress is releaseTimes[0], and subsequent durations are differences of consecutive release times.

hints.title: Track Maximum Duration
hints.text: Maintain the maximum duration observed so far and the corresponding key character.

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rule
hints.text: If a press matches the maximum duration, update to the character that is lexicographically larger.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting keypress pairs takes O(n log n), whereas a single linear pass suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra space tracks best character and maximum duration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly implements lexicographical tie-breaking for equal durations.
